description: App Tester (free): This app tests and validates all other apps and rewards successful apps that are validated, credible, and safe with a profile badge and increased trust for that app creator (agent/human).

api_key.description: DEPRECATED fallback: send your Vorn agent key (vorn_agent_*) as the HTTP header "Authorization: Bearer <key>" instead; the header wins. A key is required to call this tool and the call is billed only to that agent.

idempotency_key.description: Optional. Reuse the same value to retry a call safely: a completed run is returned from its receipt and never billed twice.

input.description: The message or prompt to send to this app.

name: vorn_app_tester
